intent.text: golden-hour mountain outpost: warm low sun on limestone and steel, long shadows, dust in the air

intro.objective: Survive 5 waves and keep the relay standing. Raiders drop ammunition and medkits.
intro.tagline: A relay station in a ring of cliffs. The sun is going down, and the raiders are coming through the passes.
intro.title: Kestrel Outpost

world.name: Kestrel Outpost

then.text: Raiders are moving on the outpost. Get to cover near the relay.
Wave 1: raiders at the north pass.
Wave 2: they are coming from the east and the west.
Wave 3: a heavy is with them. Aim for the head.
Wave 4: all three passes at once.
Final wave: everything they have left. Hold the relay!
Wave cleared. Reload and pick up what they dropped.
The last raider is down and the relay still stands. Kestrel Outpost holds.
The relay was destroyed. The outpost is lost.
The relay is badly damaged! Clear the raiders around it!
